sourceChecks.text: Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Ahimaaz.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と前後の系譜・文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Zadok his son, and Ahimaaz his son.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と前後の系譜・文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: and Zadok, a young man mighty of valor, and of his father’s house twenty-two captains.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と前後の系譜・文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites: for Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab,
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と前後の系譜・文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: and Zadok the priest and his brothers the priests, before the LORD’s tabernacle in the high place that was at Gibeon,
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と前後の系譜・文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Abimelech the son of Abiathar were priests; Shavsha was scribe;
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と前後の系譜・文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: David, with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to their ordering in their service.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と前後の系譜・文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the scribe, who was of the Levites, wrote them in the presence of the king, the princes, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites; one fathers’ house being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と前後の系譜・文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: These likewise cast lots even as their brothers the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites, the fathers’ households of the chief even as those of his younger brother.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と前後の系譜・文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: of Levi, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel; of Aaron, Zadok;
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と前後の系譜・文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: and ate and drank before the LORD on that day with great gladness. They made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him before the LORD to be prince, and Zadok to be priest.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と前後の系譜・文脈を確認。
